notes: Routes of 0..25 used slots ending at a free slot or running through all 25, with tanker and target slots, altitudes from below sea level to above the density floor (and full int32 range), speeds from 1 knot to 65535, and coordinates small enough to finish and large enough to run dry (at most 32767, so the signed squared length stays positive and the square root never takes its DOS error path). Square root and abs run as original code.
